notablePrerequisites:
Krasis Incubation attached to Crystalline Crawler.
You have an enchantment card exiled by Semblance Anvil.
description:
Activate Krasis Incubation by paying {G}{U} and returning it to your hand, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability four times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {G}{G}{U}{U}.
Cast Krasis Incubation by paying {G}{U} due to Semblance Anvil, attaching it to Crystalline Crawler.
Repeat.
